record.body:
## Evidence

behavior-bug on verdict-command: R2 requires pytest exit code 0 at --at for each claim's oracle tests

Observed: _head_passed returns true when exit_code != 0 if no FAILED/ERROR line matches the claim's node ids

## Consequence

Phase merge is blocked until the finding is fixed or cleared.

## Follow-up

Fix work-item fix-verdict-exit covers this finding. Do not reopen done tasks.
